history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-17: after the #192 curve-scale pilot (run 44125061301), the owner asked for reserve {0, 50, 100} x speed 66 x curve {100, 125, 150}: a light reserve, with the curve deciding how much healing beyond it is bought. Not a Phase Door floor (owner: Phase Door is not in the same league as healing).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-17, before any result was read. Pilot (RULES 14, zoo RULES 16); small and medium of the same
arms only after this gate and the owner. Gate: no config_error; one binary; the three
borg_param_town_heal_* lines with the arm's values (reserve 0/50/100, curve 100/125/150, speed 66) in every
arm's borg.txt and in params-core.json of the death replays; no plan loaded; every cell ends in death,
turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls, purchase bursts and key outliers listed; death bundles reproduced.
Evidence retained for every game (retain_evidence), because the main endpoint needs the surviving games'
purchases, not only the deaths'. Report per arm: deaths, final level, deepest level; paired rescued and
newly killed against r0-c100 on the same start; from every game's messages: healing potions bought (Cure
Light/Serious/Critical Wounds, Healing) and gold on them, Phase Door bought and gold on it, against all
gold spent; and town departures with no Phase Door carried (the crowding endpoint: a local simulation on
borg-reborn-rs found 38 such departures without a reserve against 114 at the shipped reserve 400, on 18
starts), by class. For reference the shipped values are 400 / 100 / 66; none of these arms is the
shipped value. 18 starts per arm show direction only.
experiment.question: On borg-reborn-rs main dd5f026e with healing speed 66, does a light healing reserve (0, 50, 100 percent of max HP) with a slower-fading healing curve (scale 100, 125, 150) keep healing without crowding out Phase Door?
